label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
Hiya you three,

Right, I've got a plan for Gran's 80th, and Gran knows nothing about it, so keep it zipped!

Morag's said I can have the salon to myself on Saturday 12th December from 1pm (she shuts at 12). So I'm going to do everyone's hair for free before we head out for Gran's dinner. It's Hair by Morag on Dumbarton Rd, you all know it. That's seven heads: me, Mum, Kirsty, Linda, Gran, Ava and Ruby. Dinner's that night at 8.30 at the Italian on Byres Rd, table booked for nine with Uncle Davie and Kirsty's man. The actual birthday is the Sunday.

Everyone's getting a cut and blow-dry, no bother. I can do colours too, but I need to order from the wholesaler, so **tell me what you want by Friday 27th November**. Miss that and it's a cut and blow-dry only, sorry!

Gran said at Easter she'd love to go silver properly, so I'm going to sort that for her. She won't have to pay salon prices either, which I'm guessing will go down well. Linda, yes, you're getting yours done in the salon this time. The cooker and the dog have suffered enough.

Ava and Ruby, you're getting wee braids and glitter spray. They'll love it.

Mum, you're the one who has to get Gran to the salon for 1 without telling her why. You know her best, so I'll leave the excuse to you. Don't let her catch on!

Last thing: bring a bottle of fizz. Morag's fine with it as long as we tidy up after ourselves, so nobody sneak off and leave me with the glasses.

Text me your colour choices as soon as you can. I'm buzzing for this.

Love you all xx
